scopeAudit.boundary: This sidecar covers only strict accepted COL26.8 species descending from exact Orthonectida root CVJLH.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

statuses.accepted: The normalized COL name directly equals one valid ITIS Orthonectida species.
statuses.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals official ITIS invalid species-name evidence resolving to one valid ITIS Orthonectida species.
statuses.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS species TSN.
statuses.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official ITIS species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Orthonectida species.

matchingContract.prohibited: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered or taxon-substituted matching is used.

deliveryContract.pagesLight: Pages needs only this descriptor and may omit row-level JSONL gzip shards.
deliveryContract.androidIosFull: Android and iOS inventories must include the descriptor and every listed row-level shard byte-for-byte.
deliveryContract.runtimeChange: This import changes no formal runtime or published release manifest.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, fixed roots, exact SQL, representation-only normalization and deterministic gzip.
